name: Shri Kempegowda (ಕೆಂಪೇಗೌಡ)
key_quotes: ನಮ್ಮ ರೇಷ್ಮೆ ಹುಳುಗಳಿಗೆ ಎಲೆ ಕೊಡುವಾಗ ಬೂದಿ ರೋಗ ಬಂದರೆ ಹುಳುಗಳು ತಿನ್ನುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. (When powdery mildew hits our mulberry, silkworms reject the leaves or fall sick).

ರೋಗ ಬಂದ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕೊಟ್ಟರೆ 100 ಹುಳುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ 60 ಹುಳು ಸತ್ತುಹೋಗುತ್ತವೆ - ಫ್ಲಾಚೇರಿ (flacherie) ರೋಗ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ. (If we feed diseased leaves, 60 out of 100 silkworms die from flacherie disease before spinning cocoons).

ನಾವು ಮದ್ದು ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿದರೆ (spray) ಕನಿಷ್ಠ 10-12 ದಿನ ಎಲೆ ಕೀಳಬಾರದು. ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ವಿಷ ತಾಗಿ ಹುಳುಗಳು ಒಮ್ಮೆಗೆ ಸಾಯುತ್ತವೆ. (If we spray fungicide, we strictly cannot harvest leaves for at least 10-12 days; otherwise chemical residue kills all silkworms).

qna.q: Which season causes the most leaf loss in your farm?
qna.a: Late monsoon into winter (October to December). When the nights are foggy and morning dew stays on the leaves, white powdery mildew spreads across 2 acres in just 4 days.

qna.q: What is your current method of checking leaf disease?
qna.a: Only naked eye. But by the time I see the white powder or rust spots clearly, the infection is already deep inside the tissue. We need something quick on the phone that warns us early.

qna.q: What would make you trust an AI app?
qna.a: It must give clear instructions in Kannada, work fast without internet lag, and specifically tell us how many days to wait after spraying before we pluck for feeding.

name: Dr. S. Manjunath, M.Sc. (Sericulture)
location: Department of Sericulture, Taluk Office, Kanakapura
experience: 14 years in Sericulture Extension & Farmer Advisory
key_quotes: Farmers often confuse early stage Leaf Rust (Cerotelium fici) with Cercospora Leaf Spot; treatment timing differs significantly.
The strict quarantine rule: 0.2% Wettable Sulfur for Powdery Mildew requires 10 days safe waiting period; 0.1% Carbendazim (Bavistin) for Leaf Spot requires 12-14 days before silkworm ingestion.
An automated diagnostic tool that calculates disease severity and enforces chemical safe-plucking intervals directly addresses the root cause of silkworm mortality.

qna.q: What is the biological mechanism of cocoon failure when silkworms eat infected leaves?
qna.a: Healthy Morus alba leaves contain 70-75% moisture and 20-24% crude protein. Fungal infection by Phyllactinia corylea degrades leaf moisture to <50% and denatures soluble proteins into indigestible fibers. Silkworms develop bacterial/viral flacherie due to digestive gut alkalinity disturbance.

qna.q: What is the official government recommendation for infected fields?
qna.a: Immediate mechanical plucking of lower diseased leaves, burning them outside the plantation, and prophylactic organic/bio-fungicide (Trichoderma viride) application if plucking is due within 7 days.

name: Dr. V. Ramesh, Ph.D.
location: Central Sericultural Research & Training Institute (CSRTI), Mysuru
experience: 22 years in Morus Genomics & Mulberry Crop Pathology
key_quotes: Silkworm Bombyx mori is a monophagous insect; its entire fibroin silk synthesis depends exclusively on amino acids derived from mulberry leaf digestion.

Computer vision models trained purely on clean lab backgrounds always suffer an 8-12% accuracy drop in the field due to variable solar azimuth, specular reflection from leaf waxy cuticles, and soil background clutter.
Engineering students formulating this project should benchmark dataset accuracy against real field test sets to demonstrate genuine experiential learning.

qna.q: Why is MobileNetV2 scientifically suitable for this problem?
qna.a: MobileNetV2 uses depthwise separable convolutions and inverted residual bottlenecks with linear activations. It reduces computation to 300 MFLOPs while maintaining high feature extraction capability for micro-textures (like fungal pustules and chlorotic haloes), making it runnable directly on inexpensive rural Android devices.
